propositions: Repository delegation must preserve the boundary between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without blurring ownership or partial-state rules.
Publication stages only the existing five bridge-state files; no independent repository checkpoints or broadened staging.
Unchanged passes create no commit; GET rotation and retired-first failure cases preserve pre-extraction publication and recovery floors.
Repository save() and save_retired() leave Git HEAD and index untouched while landing local files.
ADR 0099 documents ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, persistence-vs-publication split, rollback, and explicit no-journal/no-format-migration decisions.
Regression tests assert the five-file allowlist, unchanged-pass behavior, rotation floor, and retired-first publication semantics remain intact across the S1 cutover.
